verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents its own search, including a design goal that search should work without a network connection, and it offers Ask AI natural-language answers across the inbox. Hands-on speed reports conflict: one user calls search blazing fast, while an ex-user says archive searches regularly took ten seconds. Missing for 10: documented search operators, filters, ranked results, explicit full-history coverage, and consistent independent confirmation of search speed.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.
You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.
search and UI transitions are blazing fast
